description: Reads a live scene by path. Start with `*`: it returns the resource types (frame, source, component, element, …) and their definitions, which describe everything else. Reads the draft unless `state` or `revision` is given.

as.description: For a frame or one of its layers. image: a picture of it as it goes on air, to check the result. json: the frame as a tree of layers instead of code.

at.description: With as image: milliseconds since the frame went on air (to see an animation's later moment).

data.description: With as image: live reads the sources now, sample uses their sample rows.

overlay.description: With as image: a guide drawn over the picture. grid: lines every 10 %; ids: each layer's outline and id.

path.description: *, a type (element/Text), a resource (frame/intro), or a mask (frame/*).

paths.description: Instead of path: several paths read in one call, e.g. every element type a task needs. Each is answered as path would be, or with its error. Draft only, no pictures.

name: scene_get
title: Read a scene
